versions.changelog:
blogger-auto-publish-clean v1.0.0

- Initial stable release of the Blogger Auto-Publish skill for OpenClaw.
- Automatically publishes Markdown articles to Google Blogger with batch support.
- Includes draft management and automatic Markdown-to-HTML conversion.
- Complete OAuth 2.0 authentication workflow integrated.
- Features tools for blog listing, draft/testing post management, and blog ID lookup.
- Comprehensive documentation and example posts included for quick setup.
